title: Figure 2: comparing conventions of aircraft motion (airplane, helicopter, ideal full)
description: Three-row digital illustration (2A, 2B, 2C) pairing a wireframe cockpit seat with control inputs and a rendered vehicle with coloured motion arrows: an airplane, a helicopter, and a futuristic craft. Sub-captions read "Fig 2A. Airplane Motion," "Fig 2B. Helicopter Motion" and "Fig. 2C. Ideal Full Motion," each explaining how translation and orientation are controlled. Overall caption: "Figure 2. Comparing Conventions of Aircraft Motion. [Credit: A. Szames]."
